propose_guide: Use when NL asks for a local store, restaurant, clinic, salon, franchise, or geo-targeted promo plan. Emit Internal structure: location(s), offer, radius/audience, channel mix (Maps/GBP hints, Instagram Feed, Facebook Page, SMS/email if owned, CMS landing), week cadence, KPIs (foot traffic, bookings, coupon redemptions), and legal constraints (hours, alcohol, health claims). Prefer marketing/campaign-brief first when the goal is vague. Downstream: marketing/channel-mix → content-calendar / ab-copy → connectors (instagram/publish, facebook/publish, wordpress/post or webflow/cms-publish, mailchimp/campaign) under human gates. Do not invent store addresses or claim Google Business Profile write access unless a connector exists.

propose_guide_i18n.en: When NL asks for local store/restaurant/clinic/geo promo plan. Emit Internal structure — do not publish here.
propose_guide_i18n.zh_CN: 用户要本地门店/餐饮/诊所/地理促销计划时使用。产出内部结构——此处不外发。
propose_guide_i18n.zh_HK: 用戶要本地門店/餐飲/診所/地理促銷計劃時使用。產出內部結構——此處不外發。
